Are you a highly organised and customer-focused professional looking to develop your career? Our client is seeking aprofessional to join their team in Swindon. The Role

As a Service Delivery Coordinator professional, you will play a key role in maintaining strong relationships with both internal and external clients while supporting the management, measurement, and optimisation of services. You will work closely with operational teams, managers, and customers to ensure high service standards are achieved and opportunities for improvement are identified and implemented.

Apply today to take the next step in your career.

title: Medical Records Administrator
description:
Belmont Recruitment are currently looking for a Medical Records Administrator to join a Private Healthcare Organisation on an ongoing temporary contract. This is a full-time role working 8am to 4pm, Monday to Friday.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintain and update medical and patient records accurately and efficiently.
- Retrieve, file, track and organise paper and electronic medical records.
- Ensure patient information is correctly recorded and maintained across relevant systems.
- Prepare and locate records for clinics, appointments and other clinical requirements.

- Experience handling confidential and sensitive information.

Please apply with an up to date CV ASAP if this role would be of interest to you.
